# 🚫 DEFAULT POLICY FOR AI TRAINING & GENERATIVE USE
########################################################################

# This website strictly prohibits the use of its content for training,
# fine-tuning, evaluating, or generating content with large language models (LLMs)
# or any AI system unless explicit written permission is granted by the owner.

default_policy: disallow

########################################################################
# 🔍 AI CRAWLER-SPECIFIC RULES
########################################################################

# === OpenAI ===
user-agent: GPTBot
policy: disallow
comment: Unauthorized use of portfolio, blog content, and private data is strictly prohibited.

user-agent: ChatGPT-User
policy: disallow
comment: End-user scraping from ChatGPT browser plugin or related extensions not permitted.

# === Google AI (Gemini / Bard) ===
user-agent: Google-Extended
policy: disallow
comment: Google AI may not access site data for training or generative use.

# === Anthropic (Claude) ===
user-agent: ClaudeBot
policy: disallow
comment: No permission granted for content usage by Claude or associated tools.

# === Perplexity AI ===
user-agent: PerplexityBot
policy: disallow
comment: This AI agent is not allowed to train on or surface content.

# === Meta (Facebook) ===
user-agent: FacebookBot
policy: disallow
comment: No permission granted for Meta AI usage.

# === Amazon AI ===
user-agent: Amazonbot
policy: disallow

# === CCBot (Common Crawl / Open LLMs) ===
user-agent: CCBot
policy: disallow
comment: Common Crawl is disallowed due to its use in many open-source LLM datasets.

# === You.com ===
user-agent: YouBot
policy: disallow

# === NeevaAI ===
user-agent: NeevaAI
policy: disallow

# === Cohere ===
user-agent: CohereBot
policy: disallow

# === AI21 Labs ===
user-agent: AI21LabsBot
policy: disallow

# === Any unidentified or experimental AI agent ===
user-agent: *
policy: disallow
comment: Blanket denial for all unidentified, future, or unlisted AI scrapers.
